title: Recipe: sloth bear termite brunch

scenes.headline: Termites. Bee nests. Seasonal fruit.
scenes.body: From March to June, fruit can make up about half the menu.

scenes.headline: 1. Rip open the nest with long claws
scenes.body: 2. Close the nostrils so dust stays out.

scenes.label: how far the slurping can be heard
scenes.body: 3. Blow the dust away, then suck the termites up.

caption:
The loudest brunch in the forest.

Sloth bears also eat leaves, flowers and honey when they can find them.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Melursus ursinus). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Recipe-card format applied to a real diet: ingredients and method are all sourced feeding behaviour; Indian species, wild photos.
